map.体脂率计算（Navy 公式） 使用指南: Body fat rate (Navy formula) user guide
map.使用美国海军 circumference 公式，根据颈围、腰围、臀围估算体脂率。: Use the US Navy circumference formula to estimate body fat from neck, waist and hip circumferences.
map.男 体脂% = 86.010×log₁₀(腰围−颈围) − 70.041×log: Men: body fat % = 86.010 x log10(waist - neck) - 70.041 x log10(height) + 36.76; Women: body fat % = 163.205 x log10(waist + hip - neck) - 97.684 x log10(height) - 78.387
map.美国海军围度法（US Navy），单位 cm。男性仅需颈围与腰围，女性需增加臀围: US Navy circumference method, units in cm. Men need only neck and waist; women add hip. After clamping the result to 2%-60%, it gives a sex-specific rating of 'essential fat / healthy / acceptable / elevated / obese'.
map.无卡尺时用卷尺量腰/颈（女性加臀）围估算体脂率，适合家庭自测。: When no caliper is available, measure waist/neck (plus hip for women) circumference with a tape to estimate body fat, suitable for home self-testing.
map.对比皮褶法与 BIA，Navy 法只需围度，操作最简便。: Compare skinfold and BIA; Navy method only needs circumferences, simplest.
map.跟踪减脂期腰围下降带来的体脂率变化，量化减脂效果。: Track body-fat changes from waist reduction during fat loss, quantifying the effect.
map.：男性：身高 175 cm、颈围 38 cm、腰围 85 cm。\nwaist−:
: male: height 175 cm, neck 38 cm, waist 85 cm.
waist-neck = 47; log10(47) = 1.6721, log10(175) = 2.2430.
bf = 86.010 x 1.6721 - 70.041 x 2.2430 + 36.76 = 143.81 - 157.08 + 36.76 = 23.49%.
Male grading: <14 healthy, <18 acceptable, <25 elevated -> 23.5% is 'elevated'.
Female: bf = 163.205 x log10(waist + hip - neck) - 97.684 x log10(height) - 78.387, also requires hip input; the formula is extremely sensitive to measurement sites, strictly follow the tool's marked sites (units cm), and if the result is abnormally high first check waist/hip/neck position and tightness.
map.Navy 法和皮褶法差在哪？: Where do Navy and skinfold methods differ?
map.Navy 法只需围度（男腰+颈，女腰+臀+颈），皮褶法需卡尺多点；均属估算（误差: Navy method only needs circumferences (men waist+neck, women waist+hip+neck), skinfold needs multiple caliper points; both are estimates (error +-3-4%); Navy method is more sensitive to waist-hip ratio and measurement caliber, suitable for self-test without caliper.
map.女性为什么必须量臀围？: Why must women measure hip circumference?
map.女性脂肪分布与男性不同，加入臀围才能从围度合理推算体脂；漏测臀围或腰臀测量错位都: Women's fat distribution differs from men; adding hip allows reasonable body-fat estimation from circumferences; missing hip or misaligned waist/hip measurement causes bias, so women's input is required.
